name: Allure Eau de Parfum
desc: Allure is a multi-faceted, complex fragrance. Each note reveals itself in a unique rhythm.

name: Allure Homme Eau de Toilette
desc: Allure Homme is a sophisticated, multifaceted fragrance. Each note reveals itself in succession.

name: Allure Homme Sport Eau de Toilette
desc: Allure Homme Sport is a fresh, energetic fragrance. Clean, vibrant and masculine.

name: Allure Homme Sport Eau de Parfum
desc: Allure Homme Sport EDP is deeper and more intense. Tonka bean and amber add warmth.

name: Antaeus Eau de Toilette
desc: Antaeus is a powerful, virile leather-chypre. A timeless masculine classic.

name: Bleu de Chanel Eau de Parfum
desc: Bleu de Chanel EDP is a sophisticated woody-aromatic. Fresh, clean yet deep and lasting.

name: Bleu de Chanel Eau de Toilette
desc: Bleu de Chanel EDT is the fresh, crisp version. Clean citrus opening with woody base.

name: Bleu de Chanel Parfum Elixir
desc: Bleu de Chanel Elixir is the richest version. Warm, spicy and amber.

name: Bleu de Chanel Parfum
desc: Bleu de Chanel Parfum is the most intense version. Deep, woody and sophisticated.

name: Chance Eau Fraîche
desc: Chance Eau Fraîche is a crisp, fresh interpretation. Citrus and cedar with a clean musk base.

name: Chance Eau Tendre
desc: Chance Eau Tendre is a soft, tender floral. Quince and grapefruit with white musk.

name: Chance Eau de Parfum
desc: Chance EDP is the richer version. Deeper patchouli and more prominent iris.

name: Chance Eau de Toilette
desc: Chance is a surprising floral whirl. Jasmine, iris and patchouli with a fruity opening.

name: Coco Eau de Parfum
desc: Coco is a rich, opulent oriental. Warm, spicy floral with clove, rose and amber.

name: Coco Mademoiselle Eau de Parfum
desc: Coco Mademoiselle is a modern, sexy interpretation of Coco. Warm ambery patchouli with citrus.

name: Coco Mademoiselle Eau de Toilette
desc: Coco Mademoiselle EDT is a lighter, fresher version. Brighter citrus with the same patchouli base.

name: Coco Mademoiselle Intense
desc: Coco Mademoiselle Intense is deeper, more amber-rich. A warmer, more sensual interpretation.

name: Coromandel Eau de Parfum
desc: Coromandel is luxurious patchouli with chocolate and incense.

name: Cristalle Eau de Toilette
desc: Cristalle is a fresh, green chypre. A crystalline, spring-like fragrance.

name: Cuir de Russie Eau de Parfum
desc: Cuir de Russie is a legendary leather fragrance. Smoky, birch-tar leather with iris.

name: Égoïste Eau de Toilette
desc: Égoïste is a warm, woody-spicy fragrance. Cinnamon, rose and sandalwood.

name: Égoïste Platinum Égoïste
desc: Platinum Égoïste is a crisp, aromatic fragrance. Fresh, green-lavender with woody-musk base.

name: Gabrielle Chanel Eau de Parfum
desc: Gabrielle Chanel is an abstract floral bouquet. Luminous jasmine, ylang-ylang and tuberose.

name: Gabrielle Chanel Essence
desc: Gabrielle Essence is a richer, warmer version. Vanilla and sandalwood add depth to the floral bouquet.

name: Chanel No. 19 Eau de Parfum
desc: Chanel No. 19 is a green, powdery chypre. Bold, independent and sophisticated.

name: Chanel No. 5 Eau de Parfum
desc: Chanel No. 5 is the iconic aldehydic floral. A timeless masterpiece with jasmine, rose and iris.

name: Chanel No. 5 Eau de Toilette
desc: Chanel No. 5 EDT is the lighter, fresher version of the legendary fragrance.

name: Chanel No. 5 Parfum
desc: Chanel No. 5 Parfum is the original, most concentrated version. Created by Ernest Beaux in 1921.

name: Pour Monsieur Eau de Toilette
desc: Pour Monsieur is a classic, elegant chypre. The first Chanel men's fragrance from 1955.

name: Sycomore Eau de Parfum
desc: Sycomore is a majestic vetiver fragrance. Smoky, woody and earthy with iris.

name: Dior Addict
desc: Dior Addict is sensual and addictive. Warm vanilla-orchid with jasmine and orange blossom.

name: Dior Homme
desc: Dior Homme 2011 is the refined iris-forward men's fragrance. Elegant, modern and sophisticated.

name: Dior Homme 2020
desc: Dior Homme 2020 is a modernized version with more masculine, woody character. Iris balanced with cedar.

name: Dior Homme Cologne 2013
desc: Dior Homme Cologne 2013 is a crisp, clean citrus-cologne. Refreshing bergamot and grapefruit.

name: Dior Homme Intense 2011
desc: Dior Homme Intense is an intense iris-forward fragrance. Elegant, sophisticated and powdery.

name: Dior Homme Parfum
desc: Dior Homme Parfum is the most concentrated Dior Homme. Deep, leathery iris with exceptional longevity.

name: Dior Homme Parfum
desc: Dior Homme Parfum is the most concentrated Dior Homme. Deep, leathery iris.

name: Dior Homme Parfum 2025
desc: Dior Homme Parfum 2025 is the new interpretation by Francis Kurkdjian. Iris and leather in perfect balance.

name: Dior Homme Sport 2021
desc: Dior Homme Sport 2021 is a fresh, sporty interpretation. Citrus opening with iris and cedar heart.

name: Dolce Vita
desc: Dolce Vita is joyful and optimistic. A warm, woody-floral celebrating the sweetness of life.

name: Dune
desc: Dune is an evocative oceanic floral inspired by the seashore. Serene and contemplative.

name: Eau Sauvage
desc: Eau Sauvage is a legendary citrus-aromatic that redefined men's perfumery. Crisp, elegant and timeless.

name: Fahrenheit
desc: Fahrenheit is a legendary fragrance with distinctive violet and leather accord. Warm, woody and revolutionary.

name: Fahrenheit Le Parfum
desc: Fahrenheit Le Parfum is a richer, warmer interpretation. Rum, leather and suede add depth.

name: Gris Dior
desc: Gris Dior is a versatile, modern unisex fragrance. Neither masculine nor feminine — just elegant.

name: Dior Homme 2005
desc: Dior Homme 2005 is the original iris-forward men's fragrance. Revolutionary cocoa and iris.

name: Hypnotic Poison
desc: Hypnotic Poison is mysterious and seductive. Sweet vanilla with almond and jasmine creates a hypnotic aura.

name: J'adore
desc: J'adore is a luxurious floral bouquet celebrating flowers. Jasmine, ylang-ylang and rose.

name: Joy by Dior
desc: Joy by Dior is radiant and luminous. An ode to joy with jasmine and Grasse rose.

name: Midnight Poison
desc: Midnight Poison is dark and mysterious. A Cinderella-inspired rose-patchouli with dramatic sillage.

name: Miss Dior Original 1947
desc: Miss Dior 1947 is the original chypre masterpiece. The first Dior fragrance, named after Catherine Dior.

name: Miss Dior (2012)
desc: Miss Dior 2012 is a chypre-floral. Fresh citrus top with patchouli and jasmine heart.

name: Miss Dior Absolutely Blooming
desc: Miss Dior Absolutely Blooming is a joyful, fruity-floral. A vibrant burst of red berries and roses.

name: Miss Dior Blooming Bouquet
desc: Miss Dior Blooming Bouquet is tender and romantic. A fresh bouquet of peonies and roses.

name: Miss Dior Cherie
desc: Miss Dior Chérie is a playful gourmand. Popcorn, caramel and strawberry — delicious and youthful.

name: Miss Dior Chérie
desc: Miss Dior Chérie is a playful gourmand. Popcorn, caramel and strawberry — delicious and youthful.

name: Miss Dior Eau de Parfum (2021)
desc: Miss Dior EDP 2021 is a renewed interpretation with prominent iris and rose heart.

name: Poison
desc: Poison is bold and provocative. A dark, sweet, fruity chypre that defined the 1980s.

name: Poison Girl
desc: Poison Girl is a younger, sweeter Poison. A gourmand vanilla-toffee scent with orange blossom.

name: Pure Poison
desc: Pure Poison is luminous and white floral. A modern, crystalline interpretation of poison.

name: Sauvage
desc: Sauvage is radically fresh, raw and noble. Calabrian bergamot meets ambroxan from precious ambergris. Inspired by wild, open spaces and desert sun.

name: Sauvage Eau de Parfum
desc: Sauvage EDP is deeper and more sensual than the EDT. Star anise and nutmeg add warmth to the iconic Sauvage DNA.

name: Sauvage Eau Forte
desc: Sauvage Eau Forte is a unique water-based fragrance. Fresh, aquatic and alcohol-free.

name: Sauvage Elixir
desc: Sauvage Elixir is intensely spicy. Cinnamon, nutmeg and cardamom create a warm, intoxicating opening.

name: Sauvage Extrait
desc: Sauvage Extrait is the most concentrated Sauvage. Intensely warm, sweet and spicy.

name: Sauvage Parfum
desc: Sauvage Parfum is the most intense interpretation. Rich, smooth and addictive with star anise and tonka bean.

name: Sauvage Parfum
desc: Sauvage Parfum is the most intense interpretation. Rich, smooth and addictive.

name: Tobacolor
desc: Tobacolor is a rich, warm tobacco fragrance. Sweet, honeyed tobacco with cinnamon and plum.

name: Vanilla Diorama
desc: Vanilla Diorama is a sophisticated vanilla. Not gourmand — an elegant, adult vanilla with floral depth.
